title.zh: 图形负载：监控片好不等于产品好
title.en: Pattern loading: a good monitor wafer does not guarantee a good product

subtitle.zh: 开口率 / 疏密图形 /深宽比 /过刻
subtitle.en: Open-area fraction / sparse and dense patterns / aspect ratio / overetch

body.zh: 裸片基线；开口率高，几乎无图形负载；刻蚀进度（截面）；去除速率高且均匀
body.en: Blanket-wafer baseline High open-area fraction; almost no pattern loading Etch progress (cross section) High, uniform removal rate

body.zh: 稀疏图形；开口率较高，局部消耗小；刻蚀进度（截面）；去除速率较快；易出现过刻
body.en: Sparse patterns Higher open-area fraction and low local depletion Etch progress (cross section) Faster removal and greater overetch risk

body.zh: 密集/高深宽比图形；开口率低、深宽比大，局部消耗强；刻蚀进度（截面）；去除速率低；出现 Etch Lag
body.en: Dense / high-aspect-ratio patterns Low open-area fraction, high aspect ratio and strong local depletion Etch progress (cross section) Low removal rate and etch lag

body.zh: 局部/全局开口率；开口率越低，局部消耗越强
body.en: Local / global open-area fraction Lower open-area fraction causes stronger local depletion

body.zh: 图形CD；图形尺寸影响物种传输；与反应概率
body.en: Pattern CD Feature size affects species transport and reaction probability

body.zh: 深宽比；深宽比越大；底部反应物越不足
body.en: Aspect ratio Higher aspect ratio further limits reactant supply at the bottom

body.zh: 掩膜与停止层结构；不同材料的刻蚀速率；影响选择比与过刻窗口
body.en: Mask and stop-layer structure Etch rates of different materials affect selectivity and the overetch window

body.zh: 增加过刻：补偿密集区欠刻 ↔ 加重稀疏区过刻、掩膜与停止层损伤
body.en: More overetch: compensate dense-pattern underetch ↔ worsen sparse-pattern overetch and mask/stop-layer damage

body.zh: 过刻不足；过刻过多；密集区欠刻；稀疏区过刻；Etch Lag；疏密CD偏差
body.en: Insufficient overetch Excessive overetch Dense-pattern underetch Sparse-pattern overetch Etch Lag Sparse/dense CD bias

body.zh: 核心提示：裸片均匀性反映设备基线，产品图形还会叠加负载效应
body.en: Key point: blanket uniformity reflects the tool baseline; product patterns add loading effects

body.zh: 量测反馈：按半径与图形分组/CD-SEM / 截面与残膜；按半径分组；按图形分组；CD-SEM；截面与残膜
body.en: Metrology feedback: group by radius and pattern / CD-SEM / cross section and residual film Group by radius Group by pattern CD-SEM Cross section and residual film
